reference: Freeze all eight historical B arms before new derived candidate analysis; paired B and same-snapshot zero suffix are different references.
hard_layer: original native physical safety, ROM, force/moment peak and clearance limits
same original goals, timing and prefix

research_layer.dose_gate: absolute change in real excursion; both-joint cumulative angular travel ratio; actual phase-boundary and terminal q; time-normalized phase q shape. Full TASK only; never divide J_F by excursion to hide dose.
research_layer.jerk: Report raw + Savitzky-Golay order3 nominal 1.25ms and5.25ms; optional p95/RMS gate at same profile ratio; not mandatory compound Pareto gate.

resolution.dense: native approximately 0.25ms true dq and verified mapping
resolution.sampled: 5ms branch dq finite differences yield screening only; unsampled peaks and validated transition dynamics NOT_EVALUABLE

derivatives: np.gradient(true dq,time,edge_order=2); then second gradient; derivative across phase boundaries; no endpoint deletion
interpretation: Research sensitivities chosen on exposed prior evidence, frozen before this package derived analysis; not clinical acceptance or external validated thresholds. All profiles reported, no outcome-driven tolerance change.
